name: Signal House
headline: Portal, billing and CRM integration work for a business messaging platform
overview: Signal House is a communications platform that provides SMS, MMS and voice APIs for businesses, with a focus on 10DLC messaging. Techlio took the product from discovery and design through development, deployment and ongoing support, including the second version of its customer portal.

solutions.title: Customer portal V2
solutions.text: Registration, settings, message logs, number management and analytics pages for the new version of the self-serve portal.

solutions.title: Billing reliability
solutions.text: Investigation and fixes for rebilling issues so customer charges are applied correctly.

solutions.title: CRM integration
solutions.text: GoHighLevel integration work, including syncing notes against the right contact and showing call activity inside the conversations channel.

solutions.title: Voice interface and release testing
solutions.text: Testing and fixes for the voice app, with tickets verified in both staging and production before release.
